{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline (missing data)
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Recheck the distribution of key variables after cleaning
response_rate_f_clean = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_m_clean = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()

# Check if the sex imbalance remains in the clean dataset
sex_distribution_clean = trial_clean['sex'].value_counts(normalize=True)
arm_distribution_clean = trial_clean['arm'].value_counts(normalize=True)
severity_distribution_clean = trial_clean['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Check response rates by sex and arm in clean data
response_by_sex_arm_clean = pd.crosstab(trial_clean['sex'], trial_clean['arm'], values=trial_clean['responded'], aggfunc='mean', margins=True)

# Check if the difference is now due to arm or severity
severity_by_sex_arm_clean = pd.crosstab(trial_clean['sex'], [trial_clean['arm'], trial_clean['severity']])

response_rate_f_clean, response_rate_m_clean, sex_distribution_clean, arm_distribution_clean, severity_distribution_clean, response_by_sex_arm_clean, severity_by_sex_arm_clean"}
